messages.author: 3ddef6512d039a35
messages.subject: Image height in tablets
parts:
I'm struggling to get the height of plots correctly within a tabset to match the height of the actual image generated from renderPlot. If I manually set the height in plotOutput, e.g.:

 tabsetPanel(
      id="tabset",
      tabPanel("User growth", plotOutput(outputId = "main_plot"), height="802px"),

It gets reflected in the first div for the pane, but not the actual shiny-output-plot. 

<div class="tab-pane active" height="802px" id="tab-2802-1">
            <div id="main_plot" class="shiny-plot-output shiny-bound-output" style="width: 100% ; height: 400px">
            <img src="data:image/png;base64...." width="961" height="790">
            </div>
</div>

Am I missing something here, or in a tabset do you just always wind up with a height of 400px in the current code?

Thanks,

- Nate

messages.author: 3ddef6512d039a35
messages.subject: Re: Image height in tablets
parts: Oops - the height needs to be in the plotOutput, not the tabPanel, then it works correctly.
